nodes.label: Dark-Mode White-Flash Prevention
nodes.rationale: The color-scheme meta tag and inline pre-paint background style (#ffffff light / #141414 dark via prefers-color-scheme) exist to avoid a white flash on dark-mode systems before React mounts and the antd ThemeProvider runs. The inline background is explicitly noted to mirror the Electron BrowserWindow backgroundColor seeded in main.ts, so the native window frame and the first painted HTML frame agree before any JS executes.
